name: mailchimp-mcp
description: MCP server for the Mailchimp Marketing API — campaigns, reports, lists, segments, automations, and more.
long_description: Provides read access to Mailchimp campaigns, campaign reports (opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes), audience lists, segments, members, automations, templates, landing pages, and e-commerce data via the Model Context Protocol.

mailchimp_api_key.title: Mailchimp API Key
mailchimp_api_key.description: Your Mailchimp API key including the data center suffix (e.g. ...-us16). Generate one at https://admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/
